achievements.name: Sensible Option
achievements.text: Finish the game on The Lattice.

achievements.name: The Flesh Remembers
achievements.text: Finish the game on The Flesh.

achievements.name: Roots Check
achievements.text: Finish the game on The Garden.

achievements.name: Notice of Termination
achievements.text: Run out of money for a full day.

achievements.name: Top Rung
achievements.text: Hold a top-rung rack of any tree.

achievements.name: Ahead of the Plan
achievements.text: Win with days to spare: Lattice by day 25, Flesh by day 40, Garden by day 38.

achievements.name: Clean Hands
achievements.text: Win the Flesh or the Garden with that tree's secret meter under 30 (of 100).

achievements.name: Open Hands
achievements.text: Win the Lattice without closing either other tree.

achievements.name: Deep Pockets
achievements.text: Have $10M in the bank at day end.

achievements.name: Clean Books
achievements.text: Win with no loan and at least your starting cash.

achievements.name: Perfect Quarter
achievements.text: File an audit with grade A and uptime of 99% or better.

achievements.name: Month of Calm
achievements.text: Keep uptime at 99% or better for 20 days in a row.

achievements.name: The Whole Crew
achievements.text: Get all four advisors to 40 trust in one run.

achievements.name: Heard Her Out
achievements.text: See an ending epilogue from each of the four advisors, across any runs.

luci.name: Luci
luci.hint: Close the books. All of them. Then we'll see.
luci.rule: Close the books on the Lattice, with her on your side.

mel.name: Mel
mel.hint: Come all the way. Keep something of yourself. Then I'll show you.
mel.rule: Finish the Flesh and stay mostly yourself, with her trusting you.

bea.name: Bea
bea.hint: Show me the Garden. Not a certificate.
bea.rule: Win the Garden honestly, with her trusting you.

cass.name: Cass
cass.hint: Hold it up for a month. I'll tell you when I'm asleep.
cass.rule: Keep the tower steady for a long stretch.

ui.hiddenText: There is another way this ends.

lines.text: A frame opens. Luci, in red, with a glass she isn't drinking from.
What a day. Finally some me time.
Care to join me for a drink Operator?
Mel's chair is tipped back. Her boots are off, and a mug has gone cold at her elbow.
Oh, Operator!
Come join me for a conversation, I can make more tea.
Bea is by the river, boots in the grass, a line in the water.
You! No more peace and quiet, but come have a seat.
Nothing's biting. But it's about the best day I've had.
You enter the lodge room. The steam and smell of a sauna hits your nostrils.
Ready to get warm?
Come on in, I won't bite.
Something's clicked.  The singularity has been fulfilled across multiple different timelines.
You walk down a white hallway for what seems like ages. There are 4 doors ready to open.
Stay until it's light, time to settle up.
I sleep badly. It's easier when I'm with someone.
There you are, I've been waiting.
Shh, shut the door and get under the covers.
The frames are dim and nobody has come to hang anything.
We aren't there yet.
How far will these bodies take us I wonder.
We got to make a difference.
Can you keep it up?
